Hymn 25: Now We'll Sing with One Accord
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: G Major

This is hymn number 25 titled "Now We'll Sing with One Accord" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William B. Bradbury and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
